defs.def: to put sth together with sth else so as to increase the size, number, amount, etc. 增加；加添

ex.s: I really like the idea of adding a new column to our English newspaper.
ex.t: 我真的很喜欢在我们的英文报上新增一个栏目的想法。

ex.s: Dutch plantsman and designer Piet Oudolf’s gardens popularized this style, adding artistic flavors to the planting mixes while playing with color and form, including four-season interest and serving the needs of wildlife.
ex.t: 荷兰园艺师兼设计师 Piet Oudolf 的花园推广了这种风格，在色彩和形态上做文章，增添了艺术气息，兼顾四季趣味并满足野生动物的需求。

ex.s: Serving hard-to-find Thai dishes in an elegant atmosphere, the restaurant is true to Thai cuisine’s roots, yet still manages to add a special twist.
ex.t: 餐厅在优雅的氛围中供应难觅的泰式菜肴，既忠于泰菜的本源，又巧妙增添了特别的变化。

ex.s: You may change your class schedule during the first two weeks of the term by adding or dropping courses from your enrollment list.
ex.t: 你可以在学期前两周内通过增删选课列表中的课程来更改课表。

ex.s: The benefits of regular exercise are well documented but there’s a new bonus to add to the ever-growing list.
ex.t: 定期锻炼的好处已有充分记载，但在这个不断增长的清单上又增加了一个新好处。

ex.s: As an added bonus, it’s close to the main train station.
ex.t: 作为额外的优点，它离主要火车站很近。

ex.s: Knowing a little about a lot of things that interest you can add to the richness of a whole, well-lived life.
ex.t: 对自己感兴趣的许多事情略知一二，能为完整而充实的人生增添丰富性。

ex.s: While I tend to buy a lot of books, these three were given to me as gifs, which might add to the meaning I attach to them.
ex.t: 虽然我往往买很多书，但这三本是作为礼物送给我的，这或许增加了我对它们的情感分量。

ex.s: As I grew older and became a mother, the library took on a new place and an added meaning in my life.
ex.t: 随着我长大成人、成为母亲，图书馆在我生活中有了新的位置和额外的意义。

ex.s: 33 What does the underlined phrase “an added meaning” in paragraph 3 refer to?
ex.t: 33 第3段中带下划线的短语“an added meaning”指的是什么？

ex.s: The results are mixed For football and basketball，adding talented players to a team proves a good method，but only up to the point where 70% of the players are top talent；above that level, the team’s performance begins to decline.
ex.t: 对于足球和篮球来说，效果不一：为球队增添有天赋的球员被证明是个好办法，但仅限于70%的球员都是顶尖人才的程度；超过这一水平，球队的表现就开始下滑。

ex.s: They’re the little spots of color like throw pillows, mirrors and baskets that most of us use to add visual interest to our rooms.
ex.t: 它们是像抱枕、镜子和篮子那样的小色块，我们大多数人都用它们为房间增添视觉趣味。

ex.s: The obvious one is money; eating out once or twice a week may be   62  (afford) but doing this most days adds up.
ex.t: 明显的是钱；每周在外吃一两次或许___62___（afford），但大多数日子都这样，花费就累积起来了。

ex.s: In Peru, local farmers around a mountain with a glacier that has already fallen victim to climate change have begun painting the entire mountain peak white in the hope that the added reflectiveness will restore the life-giving ice.
ex.t: 在秘鲁，一座山峰的冰川已成为气候变化的牺牲品，周围的当地农民开始把整个山顶漆成白色，希望增加的反射率能恢复那赋予生命的冰。

ex.s: Now, several states are moving to tighten laws by adding new regulations for opting out.
ex.t: 现在，几个州正通过为退出增加新规定来收紧法律。

defs.def: to put numbers or amounts together to get a total 加

ex.s: After a few weeks, John added the sludge.
ex.t: 几周后，约翰加入了污泥。

ex.s: All this adds up to a state of hurry
ex.t: 所有这一切加起来就是一种匆忙的状态。

ex.s: For some terms, they simply copied out the correct definition; for others, they were asked to first add an error in their description of the term before  correcting the mistake.
ex.t: 对于一些术语，他们直接抄写正确的定义；对于另一些，他们被要求在对该术语的描述中加入一个错误，然后再纠正这个错误。

ex.s: Adding intentional errors facilitates learning.
ex.t: 加入有意的错误有助于学习。

ex.s: Students often attend classes in which they are not enrolled on the first day of instruction to try adding this new course to the list, as other students may have dropped it.
ex.t: 学生常在开课第一天去上他们未注册的课程，试图把这门新课加入列表，因为其他学生可能已退课。

ex.s: However, a strong smell is added so that we can raise the alarm when we detect the smell associated with danger.
ex.t: 然而，会加入一种强烈的气味，这样当我们察觉到与危险相关的气味时就能发出警报。

ex.s: Jeff broke two eggs into a plate and added in some milk.
ex.t: 杰夫把两个鸡蛋打进盘子里，加了一点牛奶。

ex.s: Jeff broke two eggs into a plate and added in some milk.
ex.t: 杰夫把两个鸡蛋打进盘子里，加了一点牛奶。

ex.s: By adding a couple of points.
ex.t: 通过加上几分。

ex.s: By adding a couple of points.
ex.t: 通过加上几分。

ex.s: By adding a couple of points.
ex.t: 通过加上几分。

ex.s: Adding the money to her fund D.
ex.t: 把钱加入她的基金 D.

ex.s: new regulations are added to the state laws
ex.t: 新的法规被加入到州法律中。

ex.s: As Alice Black points out, today’s parents’ fear of letting kids do more housework has added to their inability to feel competent and, thus, confident in themselves.
ex.t: 正如Alice Black所指出的，当今父母害怕让孩子做更多家务，这加剧了他们无法感到胜任、从而无法自信的问题。

ex.s: What does Karl say can be added to the soup?
ex.t: 卡尔说可以在汤里加什么？

ex.s: At the end of the thirty days, you will then add back a small number of carefully chosen online activities that you believe will provide massive benefits to the things you value.
ex.t: 在这三十天结束时，你再重新加入少量精心挑选的线上活动，这些活动你认为会为你所看重的事物带来巨大益处。

ex.s: But while you probably add only a small amount of salt to your food, road crews spread about 20 million tons of salt on U.
ex.t: 但尽管你大概只在食物中加少量盐，道路养护工在美国的道路上撒下约2000万吨盐。

ex.s: When it came to England, “apple” was added to show it is a kind of fruit.
ex.t: 说到英语，加了“apple”以表明它是一种水果。

ex.s: If you add un- or in- to a word, the new word usually means the opposite.
ex.t: 如果你在词前加un-或in-，新词通常意思相反。

ex.s: Learning to learn Words about different careers in science can be formed by adding –ed, -ist, or –ian at the end of the words about subjects, eg biology-biologist.
ex.t: 学习学习科学中不同职业的词汇可以通过在关于学科的词尾加上-ed,-ist，或-ian，如生物学-生物学家来形成。

defs.def: to say sth more; to make a further remark 补充说；继续说

ex.s: “But that shouldn’t be a problem for a child of your ability” she added.
ex.t: "不过以你的能力，这对一个孩子来说应该不是问题，"她补充道。

ex.s: She adds that the program’s benefits go beyond nutrition.
ex.t: 她补充说，这个项目的好处不止于营养。

ex.s: Artist Michael Craig-Martin said: “Andria's brilliant project to bring artists from all fields into direct contact with children is particularly welcome at a time when the arts are being downgraded in schools." It was a mistake to see the arts as unnecessary, he added.
ex.t: 艺术家Michael Craig-Martin说：“Andria这个将各领域艺术家与儿童直接联系起来的出色项目，在学校艺术教育被贬低之际尤其值得欢迎。”他补充说，把艺术视为可有可无是一种错误。

ex.s: She added that she had a line of staff at her door wanting to take the training.
ex.t: 她补充说，门口排了一队员工想要参加这个培训。

ex.s: “Tom built up a passion for environmental protection at a very early age," Matt added.
ex.t: “汤姆在很小的时候就培养了对环境保护的热情，”马特补充道。

ex.s: He added that he hopes people in other cities might try similar projects and post their own videos on the Internet.
ex.t: 他补充说，他希望其他城市的居民也尝试类似项目，并在网上发布自己的视频。

ex.s: Add some background information.
ex.t: 补充一些背景信息。

ex.s: She adds: “I’ve moved house many times and I always like to personalise my room and put up pictures.
ex.t: 她补充道：“我搬过很多次家，总是喜欢把房间个性化，挂上画。”

ex.s: "It brings into focus what's important to you." He added, “There are a thousand reasons to turn around and only one to keep going.
ex.t: “它让你聚焦什么对你重要。”他补充道，“有一千个理由转身放弃，只有一个理由继续前行。”

defs.def: to give a particular quality to an event, a situation, etc. 添加（特色）

ex.s: You can be the one who directs the conversation to fun topics that are ripe for others to add humor.
ex.t: 你可以成为那个把对话引向有趣话题的人，让他人有机会添加幽默。

ex.s: By spreading cheese brine on streets before adding a layer of rock salt, Milwaukee may be able to cut its rock salt use by 30 percent.
ex.t: 通过在添加一层岩盐之前先在街道上撒奶酪卤水，密尔沃基可能能将其岩盐使用量减少30%。

defs.def: to seem reasonable; to make sense 尤用于否定句
to increase by small amounts until there is a large total 不用于进行时
to make a total amount of sth 总共是；总计为
to lead to a particular result; to show sth 结果是；表示

ex.s: It was the first traditional Chinese festival added to UNESCO’s List of Intangible Cultural Heritage.
ex.t: 它是第一个被列入联合国教科文组织非物质文化遗产名录的中国传统节日。

chunks.cn: 添加新的 / 添加几个 / 添加意义 / 添加错误 / 添加视觉 / 额外好处 / 添加特殊 / 添加有才华的
